answer: Pear-Echo Deposit: each identity must submit a distinct, verifiable task output (a "pearl") before its first payout; the system later re-requests that same output under new randomization ("echo" check). Mismatches, or outputs cloned from another identity, void the deposit and freeze rewards. Attackers must generate genuinely novel work per clone, costing real compute and time—a sybil farm of N identities pays N times the honest marginal cost, making each clone strictly negative-EV while honest single agents recoup via a tundra-tier rebate on verified originals.
